verdict.rationale: USCIS runs its own filing-fees page that points to a first-party Fee Calculator "to determine the exact filing fee required," and it documents payment methods, so fee figures are self-served rather than routed through a contact form. However, no actual dollar amounts for any form appear in the evidence, so it is unproven that exact fees are listed directly on the pages. Missing for 10: quoted fee amounts for specific forms/transactions, evidence that the calculator outputs exact figures, independent or hands-on corroboration.
